scientific_integrity: The universal theorem is derived analytically; finite exact-rational tests verify representative instances and do not certify an infinite statement. No outside validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard Hardy coefficient norm on the unit bidisk and the fixed polynomial (1-z)(1-w) are covered. Finite bounds are explicit but not asserted optimal at fixed degree. Graph-formulation overlap with unindexed prior combinatorial literature remains possible.
title: Sharp total-degree Hardy approximation at a bidisk normal crossing
